name: yiru
description: Next-gen IDE for parallel agentic development

scripts.check: vp check --fix && vp run typecheck && vp run verify:repository-contracts
scripts.verify:repository-contracts: node ../../scripts/run-vite-plus-lint-profile.mjs switch-exhaustiveness apps/desktop/src/main apps/desktop/src/preload packages/shared/src apps/desktop/src/relay apps/desktop/src/cli packages/client/src apps/desktop/config apps/desktop/scripts packages/client/scripts --quiet
scripts.typecheck: vp run build:workspace-deps && vp run generate:i18n && tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.tc.cli.json
scripts.dev: vp run ensure:electron-runtime && vp run generate:i18n && node scripts/run-electron-vite-dev.mjs
scripts.build:runtime-host: vp run build:workspace-deps && vp run generate:i18n && node scripts/build-runtime-host.mjs
scripts.build:cli: vp run build:workspace-deps && vp run build:machine-key-macos -- --single-arch && tsc -p config/tsconfig.cli.json --outDir out --composite false --incremental false && node scripts/copy-shared-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-orpc-client.mjs && node scripts/rewrite-emitted-aliases.mjs && node scripts/verify-cli-bin.mjs --fix-executable --fix-package-json && node scripts/install-dev-cli.mjs
scripts.build:web: vp run generate:i18n && node scripts/run-vite-web-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-web-build.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: vp run typecheck && vp run build:relay && vp run build:runtime-host && vp run build:cli && vp run build:electron-vite && vp run build:web && vp run verify:cli-runtime
scripts.build: vp run build:desktop && vp run build:native
scripts.build:release: vp run build:relay && vp run build:runtime-host && vp run build:native && vp run verify:computer-native && vp run build:cli && vp run build:machine-key-macos && vp run build:electron-vite && vp run build:web && vp run verify:cli-runtime
scripts.build:unpack: vp run build && vp run ensure:electron-runtime && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.build:win: vp run build:desktop && vp run ensure:electron-runtime && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.build:mac: vp run build:desktop && vp run build:computer-macos && vp run build:machine-key-macos && vp run build:notification-status-macos && vp run ensure:electron-runtime && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.build:linux: vp run build:desktop && vp run ensure:electron-runtime && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb
